description: AdvanVis - Smart Gantt and Timeline is a Gantt chart that says what is late and what it puts at risk. Tasks, groups that fold, milestones and progress come with the baseline, the status of each task, the links between tasks and the critical path worked out for you, and a headline in plain English. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • Tasks from a Start and an End, or a Start and a Duration (days, working days, weeks or hours) • Groups from up to six Task fields: they fold, span their tasks and carry their progress • Progress on every bar from a % complete field • Milestones, and a timeline row with every milestone on one line • A time axis from hours to years that picks its units; weekends shaded; Today and fixed date lines (Analytics pane) • Plans with times of day: clock times, hours and a Now line • Task list with Start, End, Duration, % and Resource columns; order by start, name or data • Colour by a field with a legend, or by rule (fx); a label beside each bar • Zoom to days, weeks, months, quarters or years; scrolling for thousands of tasks • Cross-highlighting, cross-filtering by a task or a group, tooltips, Show condition • Basic headline, keyboard navigation, screen reader text and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource) • Baseline: the first plan under each bar, with the…
